notes.title: 🌋Danger in Pompeii🌋ERUPTION DATE is set!
notes.content:
📅July 25th !📅


Steam Next Fest was a blast, thank you for all the love and positive feedback on the demo! We've seen how much people enjoy educational content mixed with adventures, we got 1'000 wishlists and had the opportunity to get in touch with tons of lovely people, so again, thank you!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610445/444442cd92966840d79bb3d0b967451d51856226.png"]



And now, it's time for us to work on the release of the game. So here we are, the eruption date is set - and there's no coming back! 

With the full content, you'll be able to explore way more content and locations! You always wanted to see the Great Theater? The luxurious Roman baths? The games of the arena?

We have those. And way more! Like an eruption. That's pretty cool, no? Wait. No. It's not.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610445/5657837992326d46fe9e0531b8466ea07a2fcd3f.gif"]


Can't wait to try it out? 
Don't worry, the demo is still available for everyone, give it a try! And if you enjoy wandering through Pompeii, don't forget to give us a wishlist and leave a feedback!



Cheers!
DNA Studios

notes.title: 🌋Danger in Pompeii🌋Play the demo NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We are so thrilled to share this demo with you, and we hope you'll enjoy wandering through the streets of Pompeii and solve its mysteries!

It's a special project mixing adventure and puzzle mechanics with storytelling. The world and enigmas are based on real historical sources and were created in collaboration with a Pompei expert from the famous Institut le Rosey. Their students even participated by helping to create musics, game designs and so much more...

It's definitely an adventure game first, but we hope you learn something about ancient rome while playing ːsteamhappyː

Try the demo now! and if you like it, add it to your Wishlist!  The Demo will be available only during Steam Next Fest until June 16th!

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1592920/extras/separator.png?t=1748252625

Watch the trailer!
[previewyoutube=2PP9Eb9VUQ8;full][/previewyoutube]


https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1592920/extras/separator.png?t=1748252625

What to expect in the demo: 

Discover the first mystery and solve its puzzle
Wander through the main street of Pompeii faithfully recreated
Learn more about the everyday life in Pompeii with two side quests
... and many more things!


The full game should be released during summer.
Wishlist now to stay tuned!
